name: Shanghai Chuangli Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Chuangli Group Co., Ltd. researches and develops, manufactures, sells, and services coal mining machinery and equipment in China and internationally. It provides excavation equipment, new intelligent and emulsion pumping station systems, transmission/control products, communication monitoring products, shearers, spray pump stations, belt conveyors, and other products. The company also offers sets of technologies and equipment for intelligent mines based on 5G+AI technology and washing of coal mines, etc. In addition, it provides fully mechanized mining and excavation automation system, and smart mine construction solutions.
